name: Agent Relay
long_description: Agent Relay helps software teams work better with coding agents, and helps those agents work better as a team. It gives Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and custom agents shared messaging, session history, and access to tools like GitHub, Linear, and Slack. Teams can see what every agent is doing, run checked and resumable workflows, and step in when human judgment is needed. Run it in our cloud, locally, or on your own hardware.
one_liner: The infrastructure to run coding agents for your team

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Founder at Agent Relay (YC F26). Previously spent nearly 14 years building Tailwind, a SAAS that helps SMBs with their marketing. Led the engineering team and company to Series B, 50K+ paying customers, 1M+ users, eight-figure ARR, and 60+ people.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: Founder at Agent Relay. Previously Founding Engineer at Nango (W23) and Lead Engineer at Overview (W19). Cornell & Columbia grad. Former collegiate basketball player. Was paralyzed from neck down, fought way back to be able to walk again.

name: Halmos Labs
long_description: Halmos Labs builds automated biotech R&D on the principles of validity and interpretabillity. We run research, and simulations answering open questions ranging from wetlab experiment design to full cancer vaccine manufacturing.
one_liner: Maximum information per experiment, minimum experiments per conclusion

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Founder at Halmos Labs. Previously ML research intern at MIT (Gómez-Bombarelli's lab) and AstraZeneca, developing frontier models for drug discovery. Published at NeurIPS on Bayesian optimization with LLMs. Research intern at Cambridge in Tuomas Knowles' group studying protein misfolding diseases. Chaired Kodsport Sverige, Sweden's largest competitive programming organization.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: Founder at Halmos Labs. Previously Desk Quant at Danske Bank, building pricing algorithms and risk models across all asset classes. Conducted LLM security research at AI Sweden and quantum computing research at Chalmers. MS Engineering Physics and BA Economics from Lund University.
